transit.name: Ore Cart
transit.detail: Free shuttle on three routes, run by Colorado School of Mines and the City of Golden

transit.name: Golden FlexRide
transit.detail: RTD on-demand service covering most of Golden; Monday–Friday 5:30 am–7 pm, Saturday 8 am–7 pm

nameOrigin.text: Named after Thomas L. Golden, a gold prospector who arrived in Jefferson County in 1858.

founded.text: Founded as a mining supply town during Colorado's gold rush

timeline.text: Golden City became the capital of the Colorado Territory.
The territorial legislature convened in Golden until 1867.

sites.name: Golden History Park
sites.hours: Grounds open daily 5 am–11 pm; buildings open periodically

sites.name: Buffalo Bill Museum and Grave
sites.hours: May 1–October 31: daily 9 am–5 pm. November 1–April 30: Tuesday–Sunday 10 am–5 pm

trails.name: Clear Creek Trail
trails.length: 1.75 miles for the Gateway Segment, from downtown Golden along the creek to Tunnel 1; newer segments continue up the canyon
trails.trailhead: Gateway Trailhead, 21100 US Highway 6, and Tunnel 1 Trailhead, 22122 US Highway 6: more than 170 spaces, restrooms and shade
trails.season: All year, from one hour before sunrise to one hour after sunset; the lots’ gates close at those times.
trails.dogs: On a leash of 10 feet or less.
trails.fee: No entry fee: Jefferson County’s parks charge none.

trails.name: North Table Mountain Park
trails.size: 1,998 acres and 17.1 miles of trail on the county’s January 2026 map; the North Table Loop is 7.4 miles
trails.address: West Trailhead, 4788 Highway 93; Golden Cliffs Trailhead, 100 Peery Parkway
trails.season: All year, from one hour before sunrise to one hour after sunset. Rim Rock Trail closes February 1 to July 31 for nesting birds.
trails.dogs: On a leash of 10 feet or less.
trails.fee: No entry fee: Jefferson County’s parks charge none.

trails.name: Windy Saddle Park, Lookout Mountain
trails.size: 792 acres and 4.3 miles of trail on the county’s March 2026 map, with Beaver Brook Trail for hikers only
trails.address: Windy Saddle Trailhead, 1277 Lookout Mountain Road
trails.season: All year, from one hour before sunrise to one hour after sunset.
trails.dogs: On a leash of 10 feet or less.
trails.fee: No entry fee: Jefferson County’s parks charge none.

trails.name: White Ranch Park
trails.size: 3,953 acres and 21.5 miles of trail, the county’s largest park
trails.address: East Trailhead, 21827 West 56th Avenue; West Trailhead, 25373 Belcher Hill Road
trails.season: All year, from one hour before sunrise to one hour after sunset.
trails.dogs: On a leash of 10 feet or less.
trails.fee: No entry fee; campsites are $12 a night.

trails.name: Golden History Park
trails.manager: City of Golden, Golden History Museum & Park
trails.size: 3 acres of 1800s cabins and ranch buildings on gravel paths, with ramps to the three main buildings
trails.address: 11th and Arapahoe streets, across the creek from the Golden History Museum
trails.season: Grounds open daily, 5 am–11 pm; the buildings open now and then, such as the summer open house.
